scope: Four-case baseline only, cutoff24 Angstrom width2 Angstrom; new preparation under same imposed smooth REBO+fixed-normal KCz, not a new physical reservoir
constraints: Fixed supercell and primitive replication. Each layer mean x and y fixed to its source value; overall mean z fixed; relative mean z free. Internal primitive-periodic x/y/z displacements free. No imposed normal load.
basis: P atom-group isometry; x/y use block-diagonal per-layer Helmert complements S (d-2 columns each), z uses full Helmert Q (d-1). Orthogonal coordinates ordered x,y,z; total3d-5 dimensions79/151.

optimizer.method: L-BFGS-B on shifted extensive energy and exact projected force gradient
optimizer.stationarity_polish: If projected force max>1e-7, at most3 Newton corrections using symmetric coarse force Jacobian h1e-4, atom displacement capped0.05 Angstrom, at most8 halvings requiring force norm decrease. Preserve all stages; no forced acceptance.

stability: Positive resolved if lambda_min(symH_fine)>10*||H_fine-H_coarse||2 and lambda_min>1e-7 eV/Angstrom^2; negative resolved if lambda_min<negative of same threshold; otherwise unresolved. This is finite-step numerical qualification, not rigorous stability or full Bloch certification.
coupling: Offdiagonal xy-z block of sym constrained Hessian; report ||K_xy,z||F/||H[:,z]||F. Resolved if ratio>1e-6 and >10*||deltaH[:,z]||F/||H[:,z]||F.
verification: Independent array/basis/constraint/hash checks and fresh directional force differences at h2.5e-5 in three deterministic tangent directions; compare Hessian-vector to normalized1e-5 and absolute1e-6. Constructor only.
registration: Frozen before this relaxation, but original targets/geometries exposed; not target-blind physical preregistration
